intent: What were the biggest earthquakes in the world over the past week?
successCriteria: Returns recent significant earthquakes worldwide from the past ~7 days, each with a magnitude, a place/location description, and an event time (UTC), ordered by magnitude with the largest first. Must come from the USGS earthquake catalog with a starttime/endtime spanning the last week and a magnitude filter, returned as GeoJSON (not QuakeML XML), not a generic news recap.

intent: How big was the earthquake that triggered the 2011 Japan tsunami, and where exactly did it strike?
successCriteria: Identifies the March 11, 2011 Great Tohoku earthquake from the USGS catalog: magnitude 9.1 (Mw), origin time around 05:46 UTC on 2011-03-11, epicenter off the Pacific coast of northeastern Honshu, Japan, at a shallow depth (~29-32 km). Requires a date-windowed catalog query (e.g. starttime 2011-03-11, endtime 2011-03-12, high minmagnitude) over Japan, returned as GeoJSON, not a recalled fact.
